verdict.rationale: Telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data platform with locally run components like the Connector SDK, Hybrid Deployment Agent and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, flag or policy for disabling telemetry or product analytics. The 'tracking-and-optimizing-usage' material covers billing usage, not telemetry, so it does not count here.
